methodology: Liu & Barabási (2011); 2026 Nat Phys Rev structure-controllability survey
interpretation: Analytic controllability features do NOT beat hand-picked bridge/articulation features on this family at n=10. The bridge features are a sparse-graph special case of control-critical edges — on tiny graphs (n=10, 11 edges) every bridge IS a control-critical edge by construction, so the two sets are highly collinear. This is a HONEST negative result: at the tested scale the analytic theory adds no predictive power beyond what the bridge features already provide. Larger n_nodes (F3) will tell whether the gap opens up as the graph stops being near-tree.
